title: Arbitrary affine-space isomorphisms act trivially on the top trace source
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pur-affine-space-iso-trace-invariance, the compact-support action affineLinearTraceAction attached to any isomorphism of the affine coordinate tower over its base is the identity endomorphism of the affine trace source.

source.place: paragraph 2, geometric fibre degree-one calculation before applying the affine counit

proof.text: Construct the base change of the given automorphism using the affine-tower Cartesian square and its lift universal property. Build coefficientBaseChange from the coefficient descent and the canonical base Tate pullback. Associativity of leftDerivedUpperStarComp proves the coefficient equivariance square for arbitrary automorphisms, not just matrices. Compact-support exchange pasting then gives an isomorphism intertwining the pulled-back action and the base-changed action.

Use exists_affineSpaceTopTrace only to identify the fixed action source with the degree-zero constant sheaf. On a spectrum of an algebraically closed field, the geometric top homology calculation fixes degree-zero homology. Full faithfulness of singleFunctor and singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso lift this to identity of the derived action.

Pull back along the algebraic closure of the residue field of each base point. Cancel the base-change intertwining isomorphism to obtain identity of each pullback of the original action. Conjugate the original action into a single degree-zero sheaf map. Naturality of singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso and faithfulness of singleFunctor show all sheaf pullbacks are identity. Geometric stalk conservativity, via isIso_of_isIso_upperStar_map_of_jointlySurjective and jointlyFaithful, proves the original sheaf map is identity. Cancel the source isomorphism. The jointly faithful argument covers empty bases without a nonemptiness assumption.

proof_origin.place: paragraph 2; implemented arbitrary-automorphism base-change and degree-zero geometric descent; only the geometric-field homology calculation remains

mathlib_searches.query: The top compact support cohomology trace of affine space is invariant under nonlinear automorphisms over the base
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits on affine-space coordinate isomorphisms and real affine equivalences; no etale compact-support trace theorem.
DerivedCategory.instFaithfulSingleFunctor and CochainComplex.instFaithfulIntSingleFunctor; these support descent but do not identify a nonlinear affine trace action.

No Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry hits. Project affineSpaceLinearTraceInvariance covers matrices, ambientAffineTranslationTrace covers translations; neither states arbitrary affine-space automorphism invariance.

theorem affineSpaceIsoTraceAction_eq_id (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ)
    (e : affineTraceTower S d ≅ affineTraceTower S d)
    (sq : IsPullback e.hom (affineTraceProjection S d)
      (affineTraceProjection S d) (𝟙 S)) :
    affineLinearTraceAction N hN A hA t S hS d e.hom sq = 𝟙 _
